mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_FREELANCER_MEMBER (user_sq, freelancer_skill, freelancer_greeting_txt, freelancer_created_at, freelancer_is_deleted_yn) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{freelancerSkill}, #{freelancerGreetingTxt}, NOW(),'N')
mapper.select: SELECT f.freelancer_sq, f.user_sq, u.user_nm, u.user_email, fi.file_save_nm AS profileImgUrl, f.freelancer_skill, f.freelancer_greeting_txt FROM TBL_FREELANCER_MEMBER f LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON f.user_sq = u.user_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_FREELANCER_PROFILE_IMAGE_S fp ON f.freelancer_sq = fp.freelancer_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_COMMON_FILE_S fi ON fp.file_sq = fi.file_sq WHERE f.freelancer_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
